name: sex
description: Pleasurable sensations associated with stimulation of the genital organ.

guidance.description: There more varieties of this experience than will be detailed here. This isn't that kind of reference. Consider seeking reputable sources and see the guidelines in 'desire for sex'.

variations.name: sexual arousal
variations.description: Pleasurable sensations associated with anticipation of sexual activity.

commentaries.quote: The desire to make babies is not generally part of the sexual experience. It may be worthwhile to consider your brain's deception in this area.
Sex without love is a meaningless experience, but as far as meaningless experiences go it's pretty damn good.
Sex is a part of nature. I go along with nature.
Physics is like sex: sure, it may give some practical results, but that's not why we do it.
Sex: the thing that takes up the least amount of time and causes the most amount of trouble.

It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality; that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable, not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;
Sex does work. Why? The benefit of sex is survival over evolutionary time. Lacking sex, clonal species are evolutionary dead ends.
